title: Geometric stalk from an étale local Isom representative
statement: For a derived local Isomorphism sheaf on a small etale site, a pointed etale neighbourhood of a geometric point carrying an actual local derived isomorphism gives an inhabited sheaf fibre at that point.

source.place: Tag 09BV, local Isom torsors and passage from local sections to geometric stalks.

proof.text: Choose the given local isomorphism e. Let P be the derived local-isomorphism presheaf and η : P ⟶ sheafify P the canonical toSheafify map. The point presheaf-fibre map sends the germ toPresheafFiber V v P e to an element of the fibre of the sheafification, which is definitionally the sheafFiber of derivedLocalIsomorphismSheaf A D.
